def transform(grid):
    left = [row[:4] for row in grid]
    right = [row[5:9] for row in grid]
    # The right pattern is used when it complements the left pattern cell-for-cell;
    # otherwise retain the left pattern.
    if all((left[r][c] != 1 or right[r][c] != 2) for r in range(4) for c in range(4)) and all(
        (left[r][c] == 1) != (right[r][c] == 2) for r in range(4) for c in range(4)
    ):
        return [[1 if left[r][c] == 1 else (2 if right[r][c] == 2 else 0) for c in range(4)] for r in range(4)]
    return left
